strategy: Model successful formats and audience needs, never copy protected expression.

hooks: Before you scroll, pray this with me.
If your mind will not slow down tonight, hear this.
This prayer is for the person carrying too much.
What does the Bible actually say about anxiety?
What does Scripture say when you feel forgotten?
Here is one verse to remember when fear gets loud.
One promise from God for your hardest day.
When everything feels uncertain, remember this promise.
The Bible does not promise an easy life. It promises something better.
This verse is often quoted without the part that changes its meaning.
The moment Peter stepped out of the boat teaches us this.
Why did Jesus sleep through the storm?
There was a season when nothing seemed to move...
You may be in the chapter where God feels silent.

longFormPillars: What the Bible says about anxiety, fear, waiting, forgiveness, purpose, prayer, temptation, and hope
Bible character studies with practical life application
Christian motivation built around one clear Scripture theme
Full story + lesson videos that create 3-8 Shorts cutdowns
lyricVideoRules: Prefer original Christian lyrics and original instrumental/music generation.
Public-domain hymn text and tune must be verified separately.
Never reproduce modern worship lyrics without permission or an applicable license.
Keep lyric lines short enough for mobile reading and sync at phrase level.
visualRules: Use real moving footage before still images.
Opening 1.0 second must contain movement and one clear hook.
Avoid giant repeated title text over faces or key visual subjects.
Use 2-5 word caption chunks, centered lower-third, with safe margins.
Change shot or crop every 1.5-3.5 seconds for Shorts unless a deliberate emotional hold is stronger.
Long-form uses slower 3-8 second B-roll beats and purposeful visual chapters.
thumbnailRules: One clear focal point: one face, one action, or one symbolic object.
Use 0-4 words for Shorts covers and 2-5 words for long-form thumbnails.
No repeated title text, tiny text, paragraph text, or cluttered badges.
Text must be readable at phone-feed size with strong contrast and generous negative space.
Use truthful curiosity, not misleading clickbait.
Faces must look natural; avoid exaggerated AI expressions or warped anatomy.
Create at least 2 variants for Shorts and 3 variants for long-form; select the cleanest, clearest concept.
Thumbnail must visually match the first 3 seconds and actual topic.
contentQualityRules: Every script must have one clear takeaway and a strong emotional or practical reason to keep watching.
Shorts hook within 1 second; long-form establishes tension/value within the first 10-15 seconds.
Use modern conversational language, not poster-copy or sermon-outline wording.
Motivation must be grounded in Scripture and reality; no guaranteed outcomes, fake urgency, or prosperity claims.
Prefer specific language and concrete situations over vague encouragement.
Every factual and Scripture claim must be verified before production.
Use pattern interrupts, story tension, contrast, or a question to maintain attention without becoming sensational.
CTAs should fit the message and not interrupt the emotional ending.
lyricSyncRules: Timing must be derived from the final vocal track, not guessed from the written lyrics.
Lyrics appear at phrase level; no paragraph blocks.
Phrase start/end times must be snapped to video frames.
Target lyric timing drift is <=80 ms; anything visibly late/early fails QA.
No overlapping lyric lines unless musically intentional and visually separated.
Line breaks must follow sung phrasing, not arbitrary text width.
Final QA must review intro, every chorus, bridge, and final chorus at normal speed.
If alignment confidence is low, block publishing and require retiming.
